decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( PL01, PL02, PL03, PL04, PL05, PL06, PL07 
Received: 31 July 2014 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The roof to the three buildings shall only be used in association with maintenance works and shall not be used for recreational or any other purposes.
description: Installation of freestanding perimeter guarding to flat roofs of residential Blocks 1, 2, 3 and 4
